SLAN.description: Traffic Surface Lane (SLAN). One lane definition per key; the lane geometry is driven by NAME/WIDTH/MV_DIR plus the LANE_ITEMS list of per-node lane data (offset, impact factor, and design-code-specific values).

SKEW_START.description: Skew angle at the lane start.

SKEW_END.description: Skew angle at the lane end.

bOPTIMIZE.description: Transverse lane optimization: automatically search the transverse position of the moving load.

ALLOW_WIDTH.description: Allowable width used by transverse lane optimization (relevant when bOPTIMIZE is true).

MV_DIR.description: Moving direction. Case-insensitive. One of FORWARD, BACKWARD, BOTH.

LANE_ITEMS.description: Lane data list: one entry per node defining the lane path and per-node moving-load parameters.

NODE.description: Node key defining a point on the lane path.

OFFSET.description: Offset distance from the node to the lane center.

bSPAN_START.description: Marks this node as a span start. Used except for Canada, BS, EuroCode, Russia, Korea LRFD, Australia, Poland, South Africa codes.

IMPACT_SPAN_TYPE.description: Impact span type (India code only). Case-insensitive. Selects how the impact value is specified: IF/CDA gives the factor directly (IMPACT_FACTOR_INDIA), SPAN_LENGTH derives it from SPAN_LENGTH.

IMPACT_FACTOR_INDIA.description: IF/CDA impact factor (India code only). Used when IMPACT_SPAN_TYPE is IF/CDA.

SPAN_LENGTH.description: Span length (India code only). Used when IMPACT_SPAN_TYPE is SPAN_LENGTH.

ECCEN_VERT_LOAD.description: Eccentricity of vertical loads to consider cant (EuroCode only).
